summary: A chord-playing firmware inspired by the Orchid chord synth: each note you play becomes a chord with a bass part underneath, while a pixel plant grows on screen.
features: Upper keys choose chord types, combinable; 27 scales from any root
Two key layouts, each with a Lock mode that holds the chord type
Bass part with octaver; arpeggiator with nine patterns including a strum
Eight-pattern sequencer for chords, bass, drums and a layer, plus song
About 60 virtual analogue and FM sounds; six effects in any order
MIDI out over USB on four channels; follows or sends MIDI clock
